newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't coffee stock sale may be off - bank.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't coffee stock sale may be off - bank.

text.p: An auction of Brazilian government coffee stocks scheduled for July 2 may not now take place, said an official from Banco do Brasil which is to hold the electronic sale.
"We suspect that the auction will not now happen on July 2. We are waiting for information from the Ministry of Industry and Commerce," the official said.

The Industry and Commerce Ministry through the National Coffee Department usually informs Banco do Brasil of the quantity and quality of coffee to be included in the monthly sale at least a week in advance.
A week is the minimum notice needed to publish details of the auction so even if the bank receives details on June 30, it is unlikely the sale can go ahead on July 2, the official said.
Government officials could not be reached to comment on why there has been a delay in sending details to the bank.
